Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

import os,glob,re
def load():

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f3(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    on=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==1]
    segs=[];u=set()
    for a in range(len(on)):
        for b in range(a+1,len(on)):
            if a in u or b in u: continue
            if on[a][0]==on[b][0]: segs.append(('r',on[a][0],on[a][1],on[b][1]));u|={a,b}
    for a in range(len(on)):
        for b in range(a+1,len(on)):
            if a in u or b in u: continue
            if on[a][1]==on[b][1]: segs.append(('c',on[a][1],on[a][0],on[b][0]));u|={a,b}
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    cells=set()
    for k,p,x,y in segs:
        lo,hi=min(x,y),max(x,y)
        if k=='r': cells|={(p,j) for j in range(lo,hi+1)}
        else: cells|={(i,p) for i in range(lo,hi+1)}
    seen=set();comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==2 and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];c=[];seen.add((i,j))
                while st:
                    yy,xx=st.pop();c.append((yy,xx))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==2 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx));st.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(c)
    for c in comps:
        if any(cc in cells for cc in c):
            for yy,xx in c: o[yy][xx]=1
    for yy,xx in cells: o[yy][xx]=1
    return o
